naming_qualification_rule: Each former integration-test file crates/jit/tests/<F>.rs became a module `mod <F>;` under a suite entry point crates/jit/tests/<suite>/main.rs. Cargo therefore prefixes every test case that file contributes with the module path `<F>::`. So a baseline case `<c>` recorded under integration target `<F>` appears post-consolidation as `<F>::<c>` (same case, gained one leading module segment equal to the former file stem). The suite/target name is the Cargo binary name and is NOT part of the `--list` case path. The one exception is crates/server/tests/document_api_tests.rs, which remains its own Cargo test target (not wrapped as a module), so its 5 cases keep their bare, unqualified names. Unit (`--lib`), binary, and doctest case names are unchanged.
